sources.title: IGN RGE ALTI - terrain model (bare earth), 1 m

vertical.datum: NGF-IGN69 (France metropolitaine; overseas territories use other datums)

sources.note: Measured: GetMap CRS=EPSG:2154 BBOX=651000,6860000,652000,6861000 WIDTH=HEIGHT=20 answered 200 image/geotiff, little-endian, uncompressed, one strip, float32, GDAL_NODATA -99999. MaxWidth/MaxHeight 5010. The coverage box is the layer's geographic envelope, which includes overseas territories and much sea or foreign land: a box inside it is not a promise of data. EPSG:4326 listed but not measured; WMS 1.3.0 wants lat,lon there. Coverage (01/10/2026): mainland France with Corsica, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, La Réunion and Mayotte, each as an APPROXIMATE box. The layer's own WMS envelope (-62.95, -24, 58, 51.11) was not used: it is the hull of all of them and holds Spain, which then passed the coverage test and answered nothing but no-data.

sources.title: IGN LiDAR HD - terrain model (bare earth), 0.5 m
sources.note: Coverage is APPROXIMATE: the box is metropolitan France, but LiDAR HD coverage is partial and still growing, so a box inside it may answer with nodata. Same service and same GeoTIFF form as ign-rge-alti; vertical datum and licence not re-verified for this layer.

sources.title: IGN RGE ALTI - surface model (buildings and vegetation included)
sources.note: This is a SURFACE model, not bare earth: it includes buildings and vegetation. Unverified: coverage box, resolution, CRS list and datum are assumed to follow ign-rge-alti and were not measured for this layer.

sources.title: IGN orthophotos (BD ORTHO)
sources.note: Unverified: coverage box (metropolitan France only; overseas orthophotos exist under other layers) and the 0.2 m resolution, which is the nominal BD ORTHO value and varies by area. Tile matrix set PM is Web Mercator, EPSG:3857.

sources.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (surface model), 30 m
sources.attribution: © DLR e.V. 2021 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2021 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
sources.note: AWS open data bucket copernicus-dem-30m, one Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF per 1 degree cell. This is a SURFACE model: buildings and vegetation are included. Unverified: the per-cell object naming, the vertical datum, and whether the licence terms allow every use here; read the licence before relying on it.
